policy.scope: Bundled public visitor-parking lists for every published town.
policy.inclusion: Named or otherwise identifiable car parks with explicit public access, public operator, fee/capacity or equivalent visitor-use evidence. Current official publication overrides take precedence over OSM labels.
policy.exclusion: Bare OSM parking polygons, private/customer/resident/permit parking, specialist parking and duplicated records.
policy.note: A car park count is not capped. Every retained item must pass the same evidence rule.
